bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 170, Number 90 (Thursday, May 23, 2024)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. JACKSON LEE:
H.R. 8525.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
This bill is enacted pursuant to the power granted to
Congress under Article I, Section 8, Clause 1 and 18 of the
United States Constitution.
The single subject of this legislation is:
To hold law enforcement accountable for misconduct in
court, improve transparency through data collection, and
reform police training and policies.
[Page H3524]
